# ----------------
## Packages ##
# ----------------

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(iNEXT.beta3D)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

```

# ----------------------
## Data pre-treatment ##
# ----------------------

# -------------------- Baiau Superior --------------------

# Prepare sample metadata

```{r}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# One row per sample and explicitly order samples from oldest to most recent using 'mean.age': 
ba_sample_meta <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
  distinct(
    sample,
    location,
    top.age,
    mean.age,
    bottom.age,
    age.interval
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.age)) %>%   # oldest to youngest
  mutate(
    chrono_order = row_number()
  )

ba_sample_meta

range(ba_sample_meta$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE)      # Check the ordering

ba_sample_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, mean.age, top.age, bottom.age, chrono_order) %>%       # Check the head
  head()

ba_sample_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, mean.age, top.age, bottom.age, chrono_order) %>%       # Check the tail
  tail()

```

# Create the species-by-sample abundance matrix

```{r}

# Matrix with species as rows and samples as columns, which is the format required by 'iNEXTbeta3d()':
ba_abund_mat <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Species_ID),
    !is.na(sample),
    !is.na(No),
    No > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, sample) %>%
  summarise(No = sum(No), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0("sample_", sample)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = No,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species_ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

dim(ba_abund_mat)
ba_abund_mat[1:5, 1:5]

```

# Build bottom-up focal-vs-accumulated-pool comparisons

```{r}

# For each focal sample, we compare:
    # column 1: the focal sample,
    # column 2: the accumulated pool of all older samples.

# Chronologically ordered sample IDs:
ordered_samples <- ba_sample_meta$sample

# Names as they appear in 'ba_abund_mat':
ordered_sample_cols <- paste0("sample_", ordered_samples)

# Keep only samples present in the abundance matrix:
ordered_sample_cols <- ordered_sample_cols[ordered_sample_cols %in% colnames(ba_abund_mat)]

# Build bottom-up focal vs accumulated pool list:
ba_focal_pool_list <- map(
  2:length(ordered_sample_cols),
  function(i) {
    
    focal_col <- ordered_sample_cols[i]
    older_cols <- ordered_sample_cols[1:(i - 1)]
    
    focal_vec <- ba_abund_mat[, focal_col]
    
    accumulated_vec <- rowSums(
      ba_abund_mat[, older_cols, drop = FALSE]
    )
    
    mat <- cbind(
      focal = focal_vec,
      accumulated_pool = accumulated_vec
    )
    
    # Remove species absent from both focal and accumulated pool
    mat <- mat[rowSums(mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    
    mat
  }
)

# Name comparisons by focal sample:
names(ba_focal_pool_list) <- ordered_sample_cols[-1]

# Inspect first comparison:
ba_focal_pool_list[[1]][1:10, ]

```

# Add focal-sample metadata to each comparison

```{r}

# This will later allow to plot beta diversity and accumulated diversity against age:
ba_focal_pool_meta <- tibble(
  comparison = names(ba_focal_pool_list),
  sample = as.integer(gsub("sample_", "", comparison))
) %>%
  left_join(
    ba_sample_meta,
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.age))

ba_focal_pool_meta

```

# ----------------------
## Assemblage Novelty ##
# ----------------------

# -------------------- Baiau Superior --------------------

# Sample coverage & Beta calculation

```{r}

# Check sample coverage with 'DataInfobeta3D()':
ba_fp_info <- DataInfobeta3D(                      # Sample coverage of each comparison
  data = ba_focal_pool_list,
  diversity = "TD",
  datatype = "abundance"
)

head(ba_fp_info)

ba_fp_info %>%                                    # Check coverage values
  select(Assemblage, n, S.obs, `SC(2n)`) %>%
  head(20)

# Choose a common coverage level:
ba_fp_joint_cov <- ba_fp_info %>%                 
  filter(Assemblage == "Joint assemblage")

ba_min_cov <- min(ba_fp_joint_cov$`SC(2n)`, na.rm = TRUE)     # The min among the joint assemblages

ba_min_cov

# Beta diversity calculation:
ba_fp_inext_q0 <- iNEXTbeta3D(
  data = ba_focal_pool_list,
  q = 0,
  datatype = "abundance",
  diversity = "TD",
  base = "coverage",
  level = 0.98,
  nboot = 500
)

# Inspect the output:
str(ba_fp_inext_q0, max.level = 2)

names(ba_fp_inext_q0[[1]])

ba_fp_inext_q0[[1]]

map(ba_fp_inext_q0[1:3], names)
ba_fp_inext_q0[[1]]$beta

# Extract beta diversity estimates:
ba_fp_beta_q0 <- imap_dfr(
  ba_fp_inext_q0,
  function(x, nm) {
    
    x$beta %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(comparison = nm)
  }
)

ba_fp_beta_q0
names(ba_fp_beta_q0)

# Helper to extract beta values (another way, supposedly safer):
extract_inext_beta <- function(inext_object, meta_df, beta_name = "beta_q0") {
  
  beta_raw <- imap_dfr(
    inext_object,
    function(x, nm) {
      
      if (!"beta" %in% names(x)) {
        stop("No element named 'beta' found in the iNEXTbeta3D output. Inspect names(inext_object[[1]]).")
      }
      
      x$beta %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        mutate(comparison = nm)
    }
  )
  
  possible_estimate_cols <- c(
    "qD",
    "Estimate",
    "est",
    "TD",
    "Beta",
    "beta",
    "qD.Beta"
  )
  
  estimate_col <- intersect(possible_estimate_cols, names(beta_raw))[1]
  
  if (is.na(estimate_col)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Could not automatically identify the beta estimate column.",
        "Available columns are:",
        paste(names(beta_raw), collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  
  beta_clean <- beta_raw %>%
    left_join(meta_df, by = "comparison") %>%
    rename(
      !!beta_name := all_of(estimate_col)
    )
  
  beta_clean
}

ba_fp_beta_q0_clean <- extract_inext_beta(
  inext_object = ba_fp_inext_q0,
  meta_df = ba_focal_pool_meta,
  beta_name = "beta_q0"
)


```

# Calculate accumulated diversity of the bottom-up pool

```{r}

# We calculated the accumulated diversity of the historical pool itself. For each focal sample, the accumulated pool is all older samples.

# Raw accumulated richness of the bottom-up pool:
ba_accumulated_div <- map_dfr(
  2:length(ordered_sample_cols),
  function(i) {
    
    focal_col <- ordered_sample_cols[i]
    older_cols <- ordered_sample_cols[1:(i - 1)]
    
    accumulated_vec <- rowSums(
      ba_abund_mat[, older_cols, drop = FALSE]
    )
    
    tibble(
      comparison = focal_col,
      sample = as.integer(gsub("sample_", "", focal_col)),
      accumulated_richness_raw = sum(accumulated_vec > 0),
      accumulated_abundance = sum(accumulated_vec),
      n_older_samples = length(older_cols)
    )
  }
) %>%
  left_join(
    ba_sample_meta,
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean.age))

ba_accumulated_div

```

# Join beta diversity and accumulated richness

```{r}

ba_fp_beta_accum_q0 <- ba_fp_beta_q0_clean %>%
  left_join(
    ba_accumulated_div %>%
      select(
        comparison,
        accumulated_richness_raw,
        accumulated_abundance,
        n_older_samples
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  )

ba_fp_beta_accum_q0 %>%
  select(
    comparison,
    sample,
    mean.age,
    beta_q0,
    accumulated_richness_raw,
    accumulated_abundance,
    n_older_samples
  ) %>%
  head()


```
